tools.name: list_published_companies
tools.description: Discover company-published profiles with search and cursor pagination. Use the returned slug with get_published_company or list_company_openings. Public company information only; no applicant data.

tools.name: get_published_company
tools.description: Read a real company-published profile and its current published openings. Includes source and application URLs; no applicant data or application submission. Compensation text is authoritative; absent numeric pay and units are unknown.

tools.name: list_company_openings
tools.description: Read current published openings for a known company slug, with application URLs and the publication revision. Excludes drafts and closed jobs. Never submits an application.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search illustrative roles by keywords, company, work arrangement, and minimum annual USD base salary. Paginated; these are not live offers.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List public demo company profiles and role counts.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read a demo job description and its company profile. Applications are closed.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Read an illustrative company profile and its sample roles.

tools.name: format_resume
tools.description: Format ONLY candidate-supplied facts into resume text. Does not generate claims, save data, or submit an application. Remote use sends these fields to rolefig for formatting; omit contact details unless the candidate wants them included.

tools.name: convert_pay
tools.description: Convert one gross pay figure (USD) between hourly, daily, weekly, monthly and yearly for a stated schedule. Overtime hours are paid at 1.5x the base rate; `hour` blends base and overtime. Gross pay only: no taxes, benefits or deductions.

tools.name: check_pay_transparency
tools.description: Check a US job post against state and city pay-range posting laws (table checked 2026-10-05) for the job's state, optional city or county, total employer size and remote status. Returns the laws that may apply, what the post shows (pay range, benefits, other compensation, deadline), what may be miss

tools.name: check_job_posting
tools.description: Check a job post's schema.org JobPosting markup against Google's job search rules. Returns blocking errors, recommended fixes and a summary per posting, never the page itself. Pass the page HTML or JSON-LD as `html`, or a public page address as `url`.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_published_company, list_company_openings, check_pay_transparency, check_job_posting · Private data: format_resume · Public sink: format_resume, check_pay_transparency, check_job_posting · Destructive: format_resume.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_published_company, list_company_openings, check_pay_transparency, check_job_posting · Private data: format_resume · Public sink: format_resume, check_pay_transparency, check_job_posting · Destructive: format_resume

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
